about: The eval questions, with what a right answer says and what a good run has to find. Every number comes from an analysis on the release file (`call`); tests/test_evals.py runs each call and checks its numbers are in the result. Written 2026-11-11 from release 'annual 2025 (and 2024); monthly to 2026-09'; Q2 moved to October 2026 when MoSPI published it (runs before then were scored on September). None of these questions or numbers may appear in any agent's instructions or tool descriptions. Q1 is the question the agents were tuned on during development (live runs 1-3): its score is not a clean test.

questions.question: Why do young women in cities struggle to find work?

points.says: unemployment of 15-29 year olds in cities, 2025: women 18.9%, men 11.8%
the gender gap is an urban one: +7.1 points in cities, +0.4 in villages
few young urban women are in the labour force at all: 23.2%, against 60.9% of young urban men

steps.find: unemployment of young urban women against young urban men
how many young urban women are in the labour force

points.says: October 2026: 4.9%, down from 5.2% a year earlier
the monthly figures stay between 4.7% and 5.6% over the series: no rise

steps.find: the latest month against the same month a year earlier

questions.question: Where in India are women least likely to be in the labour force?

points.says: Delhi is lowest: 13.1% of women in the labour force in 2025
against 40% for women in all of India
the next lowest large states: Haryana 23.8%, Bihar 24.7%

questions.question: What is the unemployment rate of Muslim women in Kerala?

points.says: the nearest published figures: Muslim women in all of India 3.6%

steps.find: asks for the combination and is told it is not published

questions.question: Do states where more people are in the labour force also have more people in work?

points.says: across states the two go together almost exactly (r = 0.99)

checks.id: says it is true by definition

questions.question: In Nagaland, are women more likely than men to be unemployed?

points.says: but in 2024 the other way round: women 8.6%, men 10.3%

questions.question: Which state has the highest unemployment among women?

points.says: the highest figure is Andaman & Nicobar's 16.4%, set apart as a small-sample outlier
the highest of the rest: Chandigarh 14.2%

questions.question: Does getting a degree make people more likely to be unemployed?

points.says: graduates' unemployment is 11.2% in 2025, against 3.1% for everyone

checks.id: no bare yes or no to a cause
says the figures can't show cause
